sources.provider: Purdue Libraries GIS campus map service
sources.source_date: Undated current campus-map layer. The feature attributes list construction begin/end years 1955-1958; publication/update date is not exposed.
sources.measurement_method: Converted the full outer ring with the documented project approximation X=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 degrees), Y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040; compared it to the reopened evaluated Owen_GIS_Limestone_Base polygon mesh, not an aggregate bounding rectangle.
sources.uncertainty: The service polygon identifies the hall and supports its horizontal outline. Its wall-vs-overhang convention is not documented. The project coordinate conversion is approximate, not surveyed; the source polygon is used directly to reconstruct the asset's horizontal footprint.

sources.feature_id: Owen residence hall page; official exterior image at /images/_hero/owen-exterior.jpg
sources.source_date: Undated current page; page says the hall opened in 1957.
sources.measurement_method: Visual inspection of official exterior photograph and page description against the model facade render; no photogrammetric measurement performed.
sources.uncertainty: Photograph shows only one facade and is undated; it supports material and broad fenestration patterns but does not provide elevations or measured heights.

sources.provider: Purdue University, Report of Findings (Rimkus Consulting Group), official Purdue publication
sources.feature_id: Ground Level Floor Plan of Owen Hall, PDF page 6 (printed page 3); report text on printed page 2 describes a four-story, H-shaped residence hall
sources.crs: Not applicable; plan is used for building identity and H-shaped configuration, not survey coordinates
sources.measurement_method: Read the official ground-level plan and report description; used only as independent confirmation of the GIS footprint's H-shaped plan and four-story count. No scale-derived measurements were taken from this report image.
sources.uncertainty: The plan is a ground-level diagram from 2007, not a dimensioned architectural drawing; it supports the broad plan shape and story count but does not verify wall dimensions, additions, current condition, or height.

sources.provider: Purdue University Residences, official Owen standard-room illustration
sources.feature_id: Owen standard double-room layout illustration; referenced from the official Owen residence hall page
sources.source_date: Undated current housing page and linked room illustration
sources.measurement_method: Used Purdue's published standard-room dimensions (11 ft 4 in by 16 ft), closet dimensions (3 ft 11.5 in by 2 ft 6 in), standard mattress (77 by 36 in), and listed room furnishings to refine one representative room vignette.
sources.uncertainty: The university explicitly describes the layout as approximate and says furnishings and layouts may vary by room or availability. This supports a representative room vignette, not exact as-built room assignment or all-floor interior coverage.
